I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread: Pellow Home Living renews at 46 seats.

Sofia first posted 52 in #coastal-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it in #coastal-random, saying the 52 came from the draft and the signed form says 46. Kwame is a member of both channels, so he could already see that correction.

I also told him that my earlier acknowledgment of 52 came from the draft number. Sofia still plans to file the signed form once June has countersigned, so I suggested he confirm with her.
